reason: I already keep diaries and file ΟΣΔΕ for my growers with the ΚΥΔ software and my own spreadsheets, and the δάκος warnings come from ΔΑΟΚ and the trap counts I see myself. This looks built for one grower with his own trees, not for a consultant who handles two hundred farmers' files.
objection: I don't know if this PDF diary would actually be accepted for ΟΣΔΕ and audits, and I'm not putting my clients' data into an app from one independent developer who might disappear next year.
would_change_my_mind: A consultant mode where I can manage many growers as separate clients and export diaries in the exact format ΟΣΔΕ and the inspectors accept, recommended by other ΚΥΔ colleagues.
